tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open women's semifinals hit Arthur Ashe tonight — Coco Gauff faces newly crowned world No. 1 Elena Rybakina and Aryna Sabalenka meets Jessica Pegula, after Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title defense in a 3:33 a.m. five-set epic • [SQUASH] QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum opens Friday in Doha with world No. 1 Mostafa Asal chasing his first title and Nouran Gohar making her PSA comeback after maternity leave • [BADMINTON] Goh Sze Fei and Nur Izzuddin say they won't settle for less than gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games starting September 19 as Malaysia eyes its first men's doubles title in 20 years • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Asia 1000 Leapmotor Kuala Lumpur Cup Day 2 at The Hood features senior open brackets and pro main-draw qualifying ahead of quarterfinals Friday • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao wraps the round of 32 Thursday and opens the round of 16 — Truls Moregard rallied past Patrick Franziska while Kuai Man and Wang Yidi bowed out on Day 2

newsItems.title: US Open Women's Semifinals Tonight
newsItems.excerpt: Arthur Ashe hosts two blockbuster semifinals Thursday — Coco Gauff faces newly crowned world No. 1 Elena Rybakina and Aryna Sabalenka meets Jessica Pegula after Rybakina clinched the top ranking.

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Returns to Doha
newsItems.excerpt: The QTerminals Qatar Classic Platinum opens September 12–18 at the Khalifa International Tennis and Squash Complex, headlined by Mostafa Asal seeking his first title and Nouran Gohar's PSA return.

newsItems.title: KL Cup Day Two Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Asia 1000 Leapmotor Kuala Lumpur Cup continues at The Hood with senior open play and pro main-draw qualifying, building toward quarterfinals on Friday across five days of action.

newsItems.title: Macao Champions Enter Round of 16
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao concludes the round of 32 Thursday and opens the round of 16 — Hugo Calderano faces Tomislav Pucar and Tomokazu Harimoto meets Anders Lind at the East Asian Games Dome.
